    sourceDigest: 1c38e9ffb48e2c77cd5a6e817b2f595f435a92f9ad2b10a45579e9c7d2613175
    derivedFrom: docubricks-real-estate-tenant-estoppel-certificate
spec:
  documentType: tenant_estoppel_certificate
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - certificate-date
        - lease-date
        - lease-end-date
        - lease-start-date
        - renewal-options
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - offsets-or-claims
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - current-monthly-rent
        - security-deposit-amount
    - id: parties
      title: Parties

      fieldIds:

  fields:
    - id: certificate-date
      name: certificate_date

      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/tenant_name
    - id: landlord-name
      name: landlord_name
      label: Landlord Name
      description: Landlord name stated by tenant.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/landlord_name
    - id: property-address
      name: property_address
      label: Property Address
      description: Property address.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/property_address
    - id: premises-description
      name: premises_description
      label: Premises Description

      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/premises_description
    - id: lease-date
      name: lease_date
      label: Lease Date
      description: Lease date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/lease_date
    - id: lease-start-date
      name: lease_start_date
      label: Lease Start Date
      description: Lease commencement date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/lease_start_date
    - id: lease-end-date

      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/current_monthly_rent
    - id: security-deposit-amount
      name: security_deposit_amount
      label: Security Deposit Amount
      description: Security deposit amount.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/security_deposit_amount
    - id: defaults-claimed
      name: defaults_claimed
      label: Defaults Claimed
      description: Whether tenant claims landlord or tenant defaults.
      dataType: boolean
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/defaults_claimed
    - id: offsets-or-claims
      name: offsets_or_claims
      label: Offsets Or Claims
      description: Offsets, defenses, claims, or concessions asserted.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/offsets_or_claims
    - id: renewal-options
      name: renewal_options
      label: Renewal Options
      description: Renewal or expansion options stated.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/renewal_options
    - id: tenant-signer-name
      name: tenant_signer_name
      label: Tenant Signer Name
      description: Tenant signer name.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/tenant_signer_name
    - id: tenant-signer-title
      name: tenant_signer_title
      label: Tenant Signer Title
      description: Tenant signer title.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/tenant_signer_title
  validationRules:
    - id: certificate-date-present
      severity: error
      description: certificate_date is required for Tenant Estoppel Certificate extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: certificate_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: certificate_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: certificate_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(certificate_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: tenant-name-present
      severity: error
      description: tenant_name is required for Tenant Estoppel Certificate extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: tenant_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: tenant_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: tenant_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(tenant_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: property-address-present
      severity: error
      description: property_address is required for Tenant Estoppel Certificate extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: property_address
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: property_address
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: property_address IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(property_address)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: lease-end-date-present
      severity: error
      description: lease_end_date is required for Tenant Estoppel Certificate extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: lease_end_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: lease_end_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: lease_end_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(lease_end_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: current-monthly-rent-present
      severity: error
      description: current_monthly_rent is required for Tenant Estoppel Certificate extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: current_monthly_rent
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: current_monthly_rent
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: current_monthly_rent IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(current_monthly_rent)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: defaults-claimed-present
      severity: error
      description: defaults_claimed is required for Tenant Estoppel Certificate extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: defaults_claimed
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: defaults_claimed
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: defaults_claimed IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(defaults_claimed)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: tenant-signer-name-present
      severity: error
      description: tenant_signer_name is required for Tenant Estoppel Certificate extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: tenant_signer_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: tenant_signer_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: tenant_signer_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(tenant_signer_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: current-monthly-rent-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: current_monthly_rent should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: current_monthly_rent
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: current_monthly_rent
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: current_monthly_rent IS NULL OR current_monthly_rent >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: security-deposit-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: security_deposit_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: security_deposit_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: security_deposit_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: security_deposit_amount IS NULL OR security_deposit_amount >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:

        reviewOnBreach: true

    completenessChecklist:
